question: Horizon Drake has protection from lands. Can it be targeted by an ability from my own land, such as Teetering Peaks?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it can't be the target of activated or triggered abilities from lands, including your own.
expected.answer: Protection from lands works like any other protection ability. Horizon Drake can’t be blocked by land creatures, all damage that would be dealt to it by lands (including combat damage from land creatures) is prevented, and it can’t be the target of activated or triggered abilities from lands (including your own Teetering Peaks, for example).
